name: Notte
description: Notte is an AI-powered browser automation platform that helps developers build, run, and manage web agents for automated browsing, data extraction, and online workflows.

events.d: Start an agent to run a browser task on a new or existing session, and set URL, persona, format, and session options.
Search the web and get results, sourced answers, or structured data.
Start a Notte function run and pass required variables; optionally choose a runtime.
Start a cloud browser session with options for browser type, proxies, viewport, and authentication.
Apply documented defaults in code, remove visible UI defaults, and improve Page Observe validation and UX.
Scrape a page in a session to extract content, links, images, or structured JSON. Configure selector, model, response format, and options.
Stop a running agent by selecting the agent and its required session.
Stop a running session by ID and optionally specify a close reason.
Retrieve a paginated list of agents, with options to filter by active or saved status.
List sessions with pagination, active/system filters, and optional response field selection.
